7665.title: ACP session metadata has no retry diagnostic translation
7665.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP session_info_update branch handles only titles, discarding retry metadata before assembling diagnostic events.
7665.proposedFix: Validate retry metadata independently of title handling and agree an explicit non-terminal status-clear lifecycle before implementing presentation.
7665.caveats: Synthetic translator-plus-assembler reproduction repeated in two clean trusted checkouts; live OpenCode emission, UI, persistence, and notifications were not exercised. Reproduction source and exact output are inline in HTML under report repository policy. No automated fix: lifecycle/presentation contract is outside the one-subsystem simple-fix scope.
